info.title: RazorConsole CLI
info.description: Drive and inspect RazorConsole apps from the command line: run them in a pseudoterminal session, send input, wait for and assert on the screen, and read the component tree, focus, route, errors and logs of a Development or Debug app. Structured JSON results for CI and AI agents.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Drive and inspect RazorConsole apps: PTY sessions, input, screens, and the app's component tree.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result as one JSON object on stdout. [default: False]

options.name: --session
options.description: The session to use. Defaults to $RAZORCONSOLE_SESSION, then the current session.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: How long waits may take, such as 500ms, 2s or 1m. Defaults to 10s.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start an app in a new PTY session. Pass the app's arguments after --.

options.name: --exe
options.description: Start an executable.

options.name: --dll
options.description: Start an assembly with dotnet.

options.name: --project
options.description: Build and start a project.

options.name: --framework
options.description: With --project, the target framework to build and run, such as net9.0. Defaults to the highest one with an installed runtime.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: With --project, the build configuration to build and run, such as Release. Defaults to Debug.

options.name: --width
options.description: The terminal width in columns. [default: 120]

options.name: --height
options.description: The terminal height in rows. [default: 40]

options.name: --env
options.description: Set an environment variable for the app. Repeat for more.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: The app's working directory.

options.name: --term
options.description: The TERM value on Linux and macOS. [default: xterm-256color]

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Return without waiting for the first frame. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The session name. Defaults to s1, s2, …

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop a session: Ctrl+C first, then kill after --timeout (default 5s).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The session to stop. Defaults to the current session.

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Stop a session and start it again with the same options.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The session to restart. Defaults to the current session.

commands.name: resize
commands.description: Resize the session's terminal.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the sessions.

commands.name: use
commands.description: Make a session the current one.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Attach to a running app through its diagnostics endpoint (app layer only).

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: The process ID of a running app with diagnostics enabled.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The session name. Defaults to a1, a2, …

commands.name: detach
commands.description: Drop an attached session. The app keeps running.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The attached session to drop. Defaults to the current session.

commands.name: keys
commands.description: Press keys. They are real input: the app handles them, so Tab may do more than move focus.

options.name: --element
options.description: Focus this element first (through the app, like focus --set), then press the keys.

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: Keys such as Tab, Enter, Ctrl+C, Shift+Tab, F5 or a.

commands.name: type
commands.description: Type text, one key per character.

commands.name: paste
commands.description: Paste text, bracketed when the app enabled bracketed paste.

commands.name: raw
commands.description: Write raw terminal input.

commands.name: click
commands.description: Click a cell (<x> <y>), text on the screen (--text) or an element (--element).

options.name: --text
options.description: Click this text on the screen.

options.name: --nth
options.description: Which occurrence of --text to click. [default: 1]

options.name: --element
options.description: Click this element.

options.name: --button
options.description: left (the default), middle or right.

options.name: --double
options.description: Click twice. [default: False]

commands.name: mouse
commands.description: Send one mouse event.

options.name: --button
options.description: left (the default), middle or right.

options.name: --delta
options.description: For wheel, the rows to scroll: positive down, negative up. [default: 3]

commands.name: screen
commands.description: Show the screen.

options.name: --format
options.description: text, ansi (with colors) or json (with cells). [default: text]

options.name: --region
options.description: Only this part of the screen.

commands.name: frames
commands.description: Show recent frames of a PTY session.

options.name: --last
options.description: How many recent frames to show. [default: 1]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show the lines that changed between two frames.

options.name: --from
options.description: The older frame. Defaults to the one before --to.

options.name: --to
options.description: The newer frame. Defaults to the latest.

commands.name: output
commands.description: Show the raw output of a PTY session.

options.name: --since
options.description: Start at this offset from an earlier call's next.

options.name: --max-bytes
options.description: Return at most this much output.

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Wait until a condition holds, up to --timeout.

options.name: --text
options.description: Text appears on the screen.

options.name: --regex
options.description: A line on the screen matches this .NET regex.

options.name: --gone
options.description: Text is no longer on the screen.

options.name: --idle
options.description: The output stays quiet this long.

options.name: --exit
options.description: The app exits. [default: False]

options.name: --element
options.description: An element matches this selector.

options.name: --focus
options.description: The element with this key has focus.

options.name: --route
options.description: The current route is this URI.

commands.name: assert
commands.description: Check a condition now; exit 1 when it fails.

options.name: --not
options.description: Pass when the condition does not hold. [default: False]

options.name: --text
options.description: Text appears on the screen.

options.name: --regex
options.description: A line on the screen matches this .NET regex.

options.name: --gone
options.description: Text is no longer on the screen.

options.name: --idle
options.description: The output stays quiet this long.

options.name: --exit
options.description: The app exits. [default: False]

options.name: --element
options.description: An element matches this selector.

options.name: --focus
options.description: The element with this key has focus.

options.name: --route
options.description: The current route is this URI.

commands.name: tree
commands.description: Show the component tree.

options.name: --depth
options.description: How many levels to show.

options.name: --no-text
options.description: Leave out text content. [default: False]

options.name: --no-layout
options.description: Leave out layout. [default: False]

commands.name: find
commands.description: Find elements.

options.name: --first
options.description: Return only the first match. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Return every match (the default). [default: False]

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Show one element in detail.

commands.name: inspect-at
commands.description: Show the element and the cell at a screen position.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Show or move focus. --set, --next and --prev change the app's focus state directly and fire focus events only; to press the key, use 'keys Tab'.

options.name: --list
options.description: List the focusable elements (the default). [default: False]

options.name: --set
options.description: Focus the element with this key.

options.name: --next
options.description: Move focus forward. [default: False]

options.name: --prev
options.description: Move focus back. [default: False]

commands.name: route
commands.description: Show the current route, or navigate.

options.name: --go
options.description: Navigate to this route.

commands.name: errors
commands.description: Show errors the app caught.

options.name: --since
options.description: Only entries after this sequence number.

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep streaming new entries as NDJSON until Ctrl+C or --timeout. [default: False]

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Show the app's log entries.

options.name: --since
options.description: Only entries after this sequence number.

options.name: --level
options.description: The minimum level: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error or Critical.

options.name: --category
options.description: Only categories that start with this.

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep streaming new entries as NDJSON until Ctrl+C or --timeout. [default: False]

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Show render statistics.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the environment, the session host and a real terminal session. Starts the session host if none runs, and stops it again afterwards.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Remove stale state files that the checks find. [default: False]

commands.name: host
commands.description: Manage the background session host.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show whether the host runs, its version and its sessions.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the host and every session in it.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve these commands to an AI agent as an MCP server over stdio. -s and --timeout set the defaults of its tools.

commands.name: __host
commands.description: Run the session host in this process.

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Exit after this long with no sessions and no clients (at least 10s before the first client connects). Defaults to 10m.
